fresh_leads.title: Internship- Business Systems AI
fresh_leads.qualification_text: Education and Experience Currently pursuing a degree in business, information systems, computer science, or data science. Experience with agentic AI ecosystems/processes, project management concepts, and enterprise business systems. Examples of experience include prior internships, projects, or personal portfolio work. Experience working in a collaborative, multi-disciplinary team environment. Fluent in English (spoken and written). Experience creating AI guidance and governance documents preferred. Skills Ability to document and communicate complex concepts to audiences without expertise in the subject. Ability to develop and apply agentic AI in the context of business administration projects. Strategic thinking to contextualize internship scope in a broader sector roadmap. Comfortable working in a multi-cultural environment; values diverse perspectives. Organized and able to prioritize tasks effectively to manage multiple responsibilities. High sense of responsibility, accountability, and commitment to quality. Proficient in Copilot Studio or similar AI platform. Proficient in Microsoft Office tools including Teams, PowerPoint, and SharePoint. Success Measures Deliverable: propose at least one agentic workflow that automates a defined, high-value team process and simulate the workflow with Copilot chat. Time savings: demonstrate a reduction in time spent on repetitive or rote tasks. Quality: achieve equal or better quality output compared to current manual processes, as qualitatively evaluated by process stakeholders. Standardization: reduced reliance on individual ad hoc AI use and documented framework that can be applied to future use cases. Other Information This position is located on-site in San Diego, California, requiring regular in-person attendance for work-related events, training sessions, and meetings. Physical requirements include sitting, walking, talking, hearing, using hands and fingers to keyboard, handle, and feel; occasional stooping, kneeling, crouching, twisting, reaching, and stretching; and occasionally lifting/moving up to 20 pounds. Specific vision abilities required: close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
